li.label: discreet
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} does not repeat things. Told something in confidence, {PAWN_pronoun} keeps it, and {PAWN_pronoun} has little time for stories about people who are not in the room. If {PAWN_pronoun} ever does let something slip, it sits badly with {PAWN_objective}.

li.label: gossip
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} cannot leave a thing unsaid. Every conversation is an opportunity to pass on what someone else said, thought or did, and a secret told to {PAWN_objective} has a limited life expectancy.

li.label: fabricator
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} does not merely repeat things. {PAWN_pronoun} invents them, fluently and without apparent motive, and {PAWN_possessive} inventions are rarely kind. People believe {PAWN_objective} more often than they should.
